targets.rawSql: select count(*) as "Usuários" from users

select
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where last_seen_at > now() - interval '24 hours') as "24 h",
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where last_seen_at > now() - interval '7 days') as "7 dias",
  count(distinct user_id) filter (where last_seen_at > now() - interval '30 days') as "30 dias"
from sessions

select count(*) as "Em trial"
from users u left join subscriptions s on s.user_id = u.id
where u.trial_ends_at > now()
  and not coalesce(s.status = 'active' or (s.status = 'canceled' and s.current_period_end > now()), false)

panels.title: Novos usuários por dia (30 dias)

targets.rawSql:
select (d.day at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as time, count(u.id) as "Novos usuários"
from generate_series(
      date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') - interval '29 days',
      date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'),
      interval '1 day') as d(day)
left join users u on date_trunc('day', u.created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') = d.day
group by d.day order by d.day

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as "Pagantes" from subscriptions s where s.status = 'active'
select count(*) * cast(${monthly_brl:sqlstring} as numeric) as "MRR (R$)" from subscriptions s where s.status = 'active'

select coalesce(round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where s.status = 'active') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1), 0) as "Conversão (%)"
from users u left join subscriptions s on s.user_id = u.id
where u.trial_ends_at is not null

select coalesce(s.status, 'sem assinatura') as "Status",
       count(*) as "Usuários",
       count(*) filter (where s.status = 'canceled' and s.current_period_end > now()) as "Pago até o fim do período"
from users u left join subscriptions s on s.user_id = u.id
group by 1 order by 2 desc

select count(*) as "Buscas salvas", count(*) filter (where alerts_enabled) as "Com alerta"
from saved_searches where deleted_at is null

select count(*) as "Editais salvos", count(*) filter (where monitored) as "Monitorados",
       count(distinct user_id) as "Usuários"
from saved_tenders

select count(*) as "Total", count(*) filter (where created_at > now() - interval '7 days') as "7 dias",
       count(*) filter (where read_at is null) as "Não lidas"
from notifications

select coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) as "OpenAI (mês)"
from ai_usage_ledger
where feature in ('title', 'ask_summary', 'sheet_summary')
  and occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'

select coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) as "Jev (mês)"
from ai_usage_ledger
where feature in ('ask', 'sheet', 'fit')
  and occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'

panels.title: Custo OpenAI por dia (US$, 30 dias)

targets.rawSql:
select (d.day at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as time,
       coalesce(sum(l.cost_usd) filter (where l.feature = 'title'), 0) as "Títulos",
       coalesce(sum(l.cost_usd) filter (where l.feature = 'ask_summary'), 0) as "Resumo de perguntas",
       coalesce(sum(l.cost_usd) filter (where l.feature = 'sheet_summary'), 0) as "Resumo de fichas"
from generate_series(
      date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') - interval '29 days',
      date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'),
      interval '1 day') as d(day)
left join ai_usage_ledger l
  on l.feature in ('title', 'ask_summary', 'sheet_summary')
 and date_trunc('day', l.occurred_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') = d.day
group by d.day order by d.day

select (d.day at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as time,

panels.title: Concordância do aluno na última noite

targets.rawSql:
select distinct on (night) agreement as "Concordância", coverage as "Cobertura", below_jev as "Abaixo do limiar Jev"
from (select (window_to at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date as night, finished_at,
         (details->'holdout'->>'agreement')::float as agreement,
         (details->'holdout'->>'agreementCovered')::float as agreement_covered,
         (details->'holdout'->>'coverage')::float as coverage,
         (details->'holdout'->>'belowJevThreshold')::float as below_jev,
         (details->'holdoutRecent'->>'agreement')::float as recent_agreement
      from ingest_runs
      where source = 'nightly-category' and details->'holdout'->>'agreement' is not null) r
order by night desc, finished_at desc
limit 1

panels.description: Aluno (embeddings + vizinhos) contra o rótulo do professor em exemplos do holdout que ele nunca viu. Última execução da noite mais recente; histórico em ingest_runs (source nightly-category).

panels.title: Concordância do aluno com o professor (30 noites)

targets.rawSql:
select distinct on (night) (night::timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as time,
       agreement as "Concordância", agreement_covered as "Concordância nos cobertos",
       coverage as "Cobertura", below_jev as "Abaixo do limiar Jev", recent_agreement as "Exemplos novos (fora da prova)"
from (select (window_to at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date as night, finished_at,
         (details->'holdout'->>'agreement')::float as agreement,
         (details->'holdout'->>'agreementCovered')::float as agreement_covered,
         (details->'holdout'->>'coverage')::float as coverage,
         (details->'holdout'->>'belowJevThreshold')::float as below_jev,
         (details->'holdoutRecent'->>'agreement')::float as recent_agreement
      from ingest_runs
      where source = 'nightly-category' and details->'holdout'->>'agreement' is not null) r
where night >= (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - 29
order by night, finished_at desc

panels.description: Uma linha por noite (a última execução dela). O monitor alerta (nightly:agreement) quando a concordância cai 5 pontos ou mais abaixo da mediana das 7 noites anteriores do mesmo modelo de embedding e da mesma prova fixa (exemplos do holdout criados antes de NIGHTLY_CATEGORY_HOLDOUT_FROZEN_AT). As noites antes da prova fixa mediam o holdout inteiro e tendem a cair. 'Exemplos novos' são os rótulos do Jev depois da data, medidos à parte e sem alerta.

panels.title: Cota de processos por usuário e dia (30 dias)

targets.rawSql:
select q.quota_day as "Dia", coalesce(u.name, '') as "Nome", u.email as "E-mail",
       count(*) as "Processos consultados", cast(${daily_process_limit:sqlstring} as integer) as "Limite"
from ai_daily_tenders q join users u on u.id = q.user_id
where q.quota_day >= (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - 29
group by q.quota_day, u.name, u.email
order by q.quota_day desc, 4 desc
select count(*) as "Editais" from tenders
select count(*) as "Contratos" from pncp_contracts

select distinct on (source) source as "Fonte", status as "Status", started_at as "Início",
       finished_at as "Fim", heartbeat_at as "Último sinal", upserted as "Gravados",
       left(coalesce(error, ''), 160) as "Erro"
from ingest_runs order by source, started_at desc

panels.title: Editais novos por dia (30 dias)

targets.rawSql:
with since as (select date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') - interval '29 days' as day),
created as (
  select date_trunc('day', created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as day, count(*) as n from tenders
  where created_at >= (select day from since) at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo' group by 1),
published as (
  select date_trunc('day', published_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as day, count(*) as n from tenders
  where published_at >= (select day from since) at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo' group by 1)
select (d.day at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') as time,
       coalesce(c.n, 0) as "Entraram na base", coalesce(p.n, 0) as "Publicados no PNCP"
from generate_series(
      date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo') - interval '29 days',
      date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo'),
      interval '1 day') as d(day)
left join created c on c.day = d.day
left join published p on p.day = d.day
order by d.day

panels.description: Janela fixa dos últimos 30 dias (fuso de São Paulo); não depende do seletor de tempo.

targets.rawSql:
select u.name as "Nome", u.email as "E-mail", u.created_at as "Criado em",
       (select max(se.last_seen_at) from sessions se where se.user_id = u.id) as "Último acesso",
       u.trial_ends_at as "Trial até",
       coalesce(s.status, 'sem assinatura') as "Assinatura",
       case
         when s.status = 'active' then 'Pagante'
         when s.status = 'canceled' and s.current_period_end > now() then 'Pago até o fim do período'
         when u.trial_ends_at > now() then 'Em trial'
         else 'Sem acesso'
       end as "Situação"
from users u left join subscriptions s on s.user_id = u.id
order by u.created_at desc
limit 50
